title: PAR-138 SectionViewStyle group-1 color insertion fast slice
mode: Generated ASCII/Binary implementation and focused regression validation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Insert missing SectionViewStyle group-1 identifier and arrow colors (DXF group 62) from edited typed fields during same-version raw-carrier export.
Preserve occurrence mapping when the identifier color is default and only the arrow color changes by inserting the identifier slot before the arrow slot.
Exercise the generated control in ASCII and Binary DXF with typed readback, exact ordered raw-stream comparison, resource closure, and neighboring-record continuity.

implementation.behavior: The SectionViewStyle typed-over-raw overlay now detects missing group-1 identifier and arrow colors. It inserts a non-default identifier color before the arrow color. If the identifier occurrence is absent/default and only the arrow color is edited, it inserts the typed/default identifier color 256 first, then the arrow color. Inserted values are constrained to the signed 16-bit group-62 range.
testCases: Remove both SectionViewStyle group-1 group-62 tags from a generated source DXF while retaining its handles; confirm the parsed typed fields default to 256; change only arrow color to 23; export and re-import ASCII and Binary DXF at AC1027; assert identifier color remains 256 and arrow color is 23.
Compare the complete ordered raw SectionViewStyle carrier, unchanged DetailViewStyle carrier, reference closure, and following model-space POINT in both encodings.

limitations: Same-source-version DXF typed-field insertion/replay only; no DWG-origin typed serialization or cross-version projection qualification.
No native style-rendering or broader SectionViewStyle semantic-completeness claim follows.
No commit was created because the shared worktree .git directory is read-only.
